name: Add internal user
expected: An internal user can be added by specifying their username. The username and email address are checked against the regex format.

name: Add external user
expected: An external user can be added by specifying their name/email/username. The email address and username must not match the internal user formats.

name: Add user to projects
expected: Add a user to projects. Verify that admins can add to any role but non-admins can only add to the specified roles. Confirm the project specific settings are applied where applicable.

name: Change roles/DAGs
expected: Change a user's role and DAG assignments. Ensure non-admins can only change to a specified role (or prohibit changing role if no other suitable role available).

name: Set/change expiration
expected: Confirm that a user's project access expiration dates are updated accordingly when a date is set or immediate revokation of access is requested.
